wins.label: Record Q2 Revenue Beat
wins.evidence: Total revenue was $46.7 billion, exceeded our outlook as we grew sequentially across all market platforms

wins.label: Blackwell Ramp Success
wins.evidence: NVIDIA's Blackwell platform reached record levels, growing sequentially by 17%... producing approximately 1,000 racks per week

wins.label: Strong Q3 Guidance
wins.evidence: Total revenue is expected to be $54 billion, plus or minus 2%. This represents over $7 billion in sequential growth

wins.label: Networking Revenue Surge
wins.evidence: Networking delivered record revenue of $7.3 billion... a 46% sequential and 98% year-on-year increase

wins.label: Gaming Record Performance
wins.evidence: Our gaming revenue was a record $4.3 billion, a 14% sequential increase and a 49% jump year-on-year

risks.label: China H20 Uncertainty
risks.evidence: We have not included H20 in our Q3 outlook as we continue to work through geopolitical issues... Data center revenue also grew sequentially despite the $4 billion decline in H20 revenue

risks.label: USG Revenue Share Requirement
risks.evidence: USG officials have expressed an expectation that the USG will receive 15% of the revenue generated from licensed H20 sales

risks.label: Rising Operating Expenses
risks.evidence: For the full year, we expect operating expenses to grow in the high 30s range year-over-year, up from our prior expectations of the mid-30s

risks.label: ASIC Competition
risks.evidence: Several of your large customers already have or are planning many ASIC projects. I think 1 of your ASIC competitors, Broadcom, signaled that they could grow their AI business almost 55%, 60% next year

risks.label: Power Constraints
risks.evidence: the world, as you mentioned, limiters, it will always likely be power limitations or AI -- building limitations
